correctness.rationale: Multinomial occupancy coefficients give the exact unmarked survival and marked first-failure laws for every N and capacity split. Independent unit-rate Poisson thinning makes the first rejected-arrival times in capacity-one and capacity-two bins independent Gamma(2,1/N) and Gamma(3,1/N) clocks. Uniform Taylor expansions yield the trichotomy including the joint critical densities; a martingale maximal inequality de-Poissonizes jointly, preserving the capacity mark. Strict monotone coupling proves uniqueness of the equal-hazard-class probability parameter. The packaged standard-library checker ran 2,183 deterministic assertions, using independent rational-state recursion and direct word enumeration; it is not a proof of the limits. All boundaries 0<=a<=N and m>=0 are stated, with non-existent classes contributing zero.

value.rationale: The precise N^(2/3) number of capacity-one bins that triggers first-failure competition is a natural reliability threshold for sparse weak bins in a uniform-load system. The complete trichotomy, explicit joint failure time/capacity densities, unique 50:50 class balance and finite-N marked distribution explain failure cause as well as timing. The continuum of mixed hazards is not a contrived finite enumeration or an arbitrary unmotivated slice; it directly distinguishes minority- and bulk-dominated risks.
